name: Untamed Shift

heightening.text: You can choose up to two effects from the list. Untamed claws leave terrible, ragged wounds that also deal 2d6 persistent damage|persistent bleed damage on a hit, and untamed jaws are envenomed, also dealing 2d6 persistent damage|persistent poison damage on a hit.

You can choose up to three effects from the list. Untamed claws deal 4d6 persistent damage|persistent bleed damage on a hit, and untamed jaws deal 4d6 persistent damage|persistent poison damage on a hit.

entries: You transform just a part of your body. Choose any one effect that matches an untamed order feat you have.
